C0622.title: Man Sentenced for Processing Over 9.25 Million Yuan via Fake Installment Payment Transactions
C0622.summary: Between February 2023 and March 2024, the defendant Tong formed a team to set up shell stores, using fake shipments and fabricated transactions to cash out over 9.25 million yuan from online consumer credit funds.
